integrity: The lower bound writes each matched-pair contribution as one plus a nonnegative surplus. The two leaf ends force disjoint surplus blocks of size at least two when n is at least four, giving weight at least n+4. Equality rules out the one-unit leaf exceptions, forces every interior pair to be exactly one 1 and one 0, and outer independence then forces a unique staircase threshold. The two surviving weight-three endpoint patterns at each end give exactly 4(n-1) minima.
scientific_limitations: The minimum-function classification is stated for half graphs H_n with n at least four; H_2 and H_3 have extra minimum-function shapes.
Only minimum outer-independent double Italian functions are classified; the full weight enumerator is not determined.
Finite exhaustive verification covers H_4 and H_5 and is corroborative rather than a proof for arbitrary n.
A differently phrased or non-indexed treatment of the same half-graph family may exist; one relevant graph-products paper was identifiable but not fully accessible in the inspected route.
title: Outer-independent double Italian domination of half graphs
